title: Let the prompt box flip with the reading direction
goal: uses logical attributes to express the padding and border of the starting point within the line.
summary: The same description component needs to be used for Chinese and right-to-left pages. Both versions display an emphasis line on the side where reading begins.
tasks: gives .callout’s inline starting edge a 3px solid line #125a46.
only adds 12px padding to the starting edge of the line.

example.note: In horizontal writing, when the direction is ltr, the starting point is left, and when the direction is rtl, the starting point is right.

hint: uses inline-start as the attribute name to make the rules adaptive to the direction.
